issue.title: Bug: [Trixie] systemd-networkd.socket starts on non-smartswitch platforms

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

systemd-networkd.socket isn't expected to start on non-smartswitch npu/dpu platforms. However we see it tries to start and we see following errors in syslog.

```
ERR systemd[1]: Failed to listen on systemd-networkd.socket - Network Service Netlink Socket.
WARNING systemd[1]: systemd-networkd.socket: Failed with result 'service-start-limit-hit'.
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Install Debian 13 based sonic image on non-smartswitch platform

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

### Actual Behavior
systemd-networkd.socket tries to start on non-smartswitch platforms

### Expected Behavior
We shouldn't see any errors and ideally we shouldn't start systemd-networkd.socket on non-smartswitch platforms.

### Relevant log output

```shell
root@sonic:/home/admin# systemctl status systemd-networkd.socket
× systemd-networkd.socket - Network Service Netlink Socket
     Loaded: loaded (/usr/lib/systemd/system/systemd-networkd.socket; disabled; preset: enabled)
     Active: failed (Result: service-start-limit-hit) since Thu 2025-11-13 <IPV6> UTC; 38s ago
   Duration: 1min 8.775s
 Invocation: 0fb94c68161a4024837ff54c92e7eb71
   Triggers: ● systemd-networkd.service
       Docs: man:systemd-networkd.service(8)
             man:rtnetlink(7)
     Listen: route 1361 (Netlink)

root@sonic:/home/admin# systemctl list-dependencies --reverse systemd-networkd.socket
systemd-networkd.socket
○ └─systemd-networkd.service
```

systemd-networkd.service doesn't start as expected on non-smartswitch platforms because of ExecCondition option. However we don't such such option for the socket

```
root@sonic:/home/admin# systemctl status systemd-networkd
○ systemd-networkd.service - Network Configuration
     Loaded: loaded (/usr/lib/systemd/system/systemd-networkd.service; disabled; preset: enabled)
    Drop-In: /usr/lib/systemd/system/systemd-networkd.service.d
             └─override.conf
     Active: inactive (dead) (Result: exec-condition) since Thu 2025-11-13 <IPV6> UTC; 1min 30s ago
 Invocation: 207328a3ce1d4861a43b389d393f6d37
TriggeredBy: × systemd-networkd.socket
       Docs: man:systemd-networkd.service(8)
             man:org.freedesktop.network1(5)
    Process: 25127 ExecCondition=/bin/bash /usr/local/bin/is-npu-or-dpu.sh (code=exited, status=1/FAILURE)
   FD Store: 0 (limit: 512)
```

resolution.title: [systemd]: Mask systemd-networkd on non-smart-switch platforms
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

Fix #25091
Fix #24523

After a successful SONiC warm-reboot, the serial console prints repeated `[DEPEND] Dependency failed for systemd-networkd-persistent-storage.service` and similar messages on non-smart-switch platforms. This is a cosmetic issue that does not affect functionality but is jarring for anyone monitoring startup output.

The root cause is that `systemd-networkd.service` uses an `ExecCondition` to skip execution on non-smart-switch platforms. However, its dependent services (`systemd-networkd-persistent-storage.service`, `systemd-networkd-wait-online.service`) still attempt to start and fail with dependency errors.

#### How I did it

* Added `mask_networkd_for_non_smart_switch()` function to systemd-sonic-generator that creates a symlink to `/dev/null` for `systemd-networkd.service` when not on smart-switch platforms (DPU/NPU)
* The masking occurs at early boot during generator execution, before systemd loads unit files
* Masking systemd-networkd directly causes all dependent services to be automatically skipped by systemd's dependency resolution
* Added `validate_masked_services()` test to verify correct masking behavior across all platform configurations

#### How to verify it

1. Build a SONiC image with this change
2. Boot on a non-smart-switch platform (no DPU/DPUS in platform.json)
3. Perform a warm-reboot: `warm-reboot`
4. Monitor serial console output
5. Verify no "Dependency failed for systemd-networkd-persistent-storage.service" or similar messages appear

#### Description for the changelog

Mask systemd-networkd.service on non-smart-switch platforms to prevent dependency failure
